blurb: Luhrs Landing offers daily and weekly rentals of Avalon pontoon boats and single or two-person kayaks on Torch Lake and connected lakes and rivers. They also provide slip rentals, boat sales, launch services, winterization, dock and lift sales and installation, and boat prep services. Located in Rapid City, Michigan, they are an authorized dealer for Avalon pontoons and other marine equipment.
